name: Kimi-K3.1-Pro layer-at-a-time prefill adapter (restricted MXFP4 experts)
license: MIT (original mlx2 code; equations only, no source copied)

checkpoint.note: Ships no modeling file. Real weights were not downloaded or run by this work.

sources.license: Kimi K3 License; DeepSeek-V3-derived parts Apache-2.0
mechanisms: KDA with gate_lower_bound via FLA chunk_kda(use_gate_in_kernel=True)
NoPE MLA with output gate, KimiRMSNorm default eps 1e-6 on q_a/kv_a norms
noaux_tc sigmoid router, latent MoE with routed_expert_norm after the weighted sum
sources.modifications: Re-expressed as MLX pure functions over a flat per-layer weight dict; prefill only (no cache).

mechanisms: lower-bound gate g = lb * sigmoid(exp(A_log[i_h]) * (a + dt_bias)): A_log is read per head
sources.modifications: Uses mlx2's existing compute_lower_bound_g and gated_delta_ops/kernel.

mechanisms: K3.1 DSA indexer: wq_b on the q latent, wk + bias LayerNorm (fp32, rms_norm_eps), weights_proj scaled by (Dh*H)^-1/2, relu-sum score, causal top-k 2048
sources.modifications: Dense MLX scoring with an explicit top-k mask in query-row chunks; skipped (exactly dense) when T <= top-k.

mechanisms: DSA indexer and top-k mask cross-check
K3 attention residual and latent MoE cross-check
latent norm after the latent reduction
DSA config validation (dsa_layers == full_attn_layers, rope 0, freq 1, layernorm)
MXFP4 packed U8 -> uint32 view onto MLX mxfp4 (same bit layout)
sources.modifications: No code copied; no Apple header.

disagreements: A_log [head_dim=128] with 96 KDA heads: vendor K3 + FLA kernel, SGLang, llama.cpp and mlx-lm consume A_log[:96] per head; the tiny-random/kimi-k3.1-pro bundled modeling file was patched by its uploader (create_model.py) to a per-channel [head_dim] decay shared by all heads. mlx2 follows the vendor/FLA per-head reading.
q_a_layernorm/kv_a_layernorm eps: vendor K3 file 1e-6 (KimiRMSNorm default) and mlx-lm 1e-6; vLLM #66145 and llama.cpp use rms_norm_eps 1e-5. mlx2 uses 1e-6 (K31Config.mla_latent_norm_eps).
index_skip_topk_offset=1: parsed by vLLM/SGLang configs but used by no public forward; mlx2 admits only 1 and ignores it.
KDA q/k l2norm eps: FLA 1e-6 (mlx2, mlx-lm) vs llama.cpp rms_norm_eps.
Task brief placed routed_expert_norm before the experts; every stack (vendor, SGLang, llama.cpp, mlx-lm) applies it to the weighted expert sum before routed_expert_up_proj.

validation.device: CPU (GPU held by another job; gated_delta_kernel GPU path not exercised)
results: MXFP4: all 768 tiny expert matrices dequantize bit-exactly (MLX mxfp4 vs independent numpy E2M1/E8M0 reference); quantized_matmul matches
layer stream from files == whole-model forward, bf16 and q8: array_equal on all logits
restricted route with every expert present == full route: max abs diff 0.0
restricted subset output vs dense numpy reference within 2% of max
FP32 whole model vs independent PyTorch transcription of the vendor K3 reference: max rel err 1.56e-6, argmax equal on all 12 positions
DSA sparse attention (top-k 3 override) vs independent numpy: < 1e-4 rel; top-k mask equals brute force; row chunking exact
q8 vs bf16 tiny logits cosine > 0.99 (tiny q8 rule quantizes only last-dim-64 matrices)
real config.json parses with 1-based layer lists: 69 KDA, 24 MLA/DSA (0-based 3,7,...,91,92)
